opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to join Forsage through a referral-based Ethereum matrix and promotes unusually high returns. It says, "You can start from the price of 0.5 ETH and earn upto 1000 ETH" and claims that "100% of your income is guaranteed and transparent, the project is risk-free." The described X3 and X4 structures use participant positions, slots, and upgrades, while Forsage-branded diagrams show tiered arrangements, Ethereum amounts, and wallet areas. A WhatsApp number and forsagetron.io address provide a route for participation. Although the speaker later says, "Income is not guaranteed," that qualification does not remove the earlier promotion of joining, slot-based profit, and a zero-risk income opportunity.
